answer: Each agent registers a cryptographic stake that is bound to a reputation ledger called the Meadow ledger; the stake is a pearl‑sized token whose value grows with verified contributions, and every new identity must lock an amount proportional to the square of its desired weight. When an agent requests a decision, the protocol aggregates votes using quadratic weighting, so a thousand saffron‑bright low‑stake identities together count no more than a single well‑established node.
